```{r setup}
library(abninferencestudy)
```

# Generate simulated data for a set of parameters
```{r}
# set the parameters to simulated data
n <- 100 # number of observations
p <- 8 # number of nodes in the graph
nodedists <- "balanced" # nodes distribution
d <- 0.6 # density
mp <- 3 # maximal number of parents
n_graphs <- 10 # number of graphs to simulate
path.outfile <- here::here()
rngSEED <- 12345L

# run the code to simulate the data
simulateABNdata(n = n, p = p, nodedists = nodedists, d = d, max_parents = mp, 
                n_graphs = n_graphs, path.outfile = path.outfile, rngSEED = rngSEED)

# load the data to check
load(here::here("data", "n_100_p_8_nodedists_balanced_d_06_mp_3_graph2.Rdata"))
```

# Generate simulated data for all possible combinations of parameters
```{r}
# set the parameters
n_graphs <- 10 # number of graphs to simulate
path.outfile <- here::here()
rngSEED <- 12345L

n <- 100 # number of observations
p_range <- c(4,8,12,16,20) # number of nodes
d_range <- c(0.2,0.4,0.6) # density
mp_range <- c(2:8) # maximal number of parents
nodedists_range <- c("balanced","G","B","M")  # distribution of nodes

# run the code to simulate the data
for (p in p_range){
  for (nodedists in nodedists_range){
    for (d in d_range){
      for (mp in unique(c(mp_range,p-1))){
        simulateABNdata(n = n, p = p, nodedists = nodedists, d = d, max_parents = mp, 
                n_graphs = n_graphs, path.outfile = path.outfile, rngSEED = rngSEED)
      }
    }
  }
}

# load the data 
load(here::here("data", "n_100_p_8_nodedists_balanced_d_06_mp_3_graph2.Rdata"))
```
